raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 13 (377 rows, ingested 2026-01-18) was delivered with source_tz='UTC' instead of America/Chicago. Its timestamps run from 12:00 to about 04:59 UTC, so late-evening 2026-01-17 local transactions spill into 2026-01-18 00:00-06:00 and land on the wrong txn_date. The pipeline ignores source_tz; converting the UTC rows to Chicago local time (UTC-6 in January, no DST in the data window) restores the correct timestamps and dates.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.85, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(CASE WHEN source_tz = 'UTC' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CASE WHEN source_tz = 'UTC' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
